objective: Proof, written before the run: for a fill with a middle knot, a near end knot and a far end knot, the moved splits and the new crossings (any base); under the sign, clause (a) holds and SEED accepts iff the moved splits are exactly the crossers of one unmoved crossed split, on a base of two orders iff they are one whole order; a pair pattern that implies the copy step; counterexamples on a base of seven distinctions with knots on pairs that share no knot, in both directions.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (written before ticket B's freeze): L1-L6 and Proposition 7; under the far-pair sign the copy step is one set comparison (the moved splits against one whole order); neither direction of sign = copy step follows from the fill and the two orders (seven-distinction counterexamples). F1, T1, T2 on SEEDK's knot-local fills not proved.
title: What the far-pair sign decides, and where it stops
